label.purpose: Folios, plate captions, nav, form labels.

shadows.name: seal-shadow
shadows.purpose: The single raised object: the bath seal.

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: Square, ink-filled action used for enquiries.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { background: #1b211e; color: #f3eee5; border: 1px solid #1b211e; border-radius: 0; padding: 10px 16px; font: 11px Karla, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .14em; text-transform: uppercase; transition: background .3s, color .3s; } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: #a45436; border-color: #a45436; } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a45436; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Field
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 5px; } .ds-field span { font: 10px Karla, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4a5a4c; } .ds-field input { background: transparent; border: 0; border-bottom: 1px solid rgba(27,33,30,.22); border-radius: 0; padding: 7px 0; color: #1b211e; caret-color: #a45436; } .ds-field input:focus { outline: none; border-bottom-color: #a45436; } .ds-field input:user-invalid { border-bottom-color: #a45436; }

components.name: Tab Rail
components.description: Notched index tabs over the hero photograph.
components.css: .ds-tabs { display: grid; gap: 2px; } .ds-tabs a { background: rgba(237,231,219,.94); color: #1b211e; padding: 9px 34px 9px 14px; font: 10px Karla, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; clip-path: polygon(12px 0,100% 0,100% 100%,12px 100%,0 50%); } .ds-tabs a:hover, .ds-tabs a.is-current { background: #a45436; color: #fff; } .ds-tabs a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid #a45436; outline-offset: 4px; }

components.name: Plate
components.description: Numbered photograph with a hairline caption row.
components.css: .ds-plate { margin: 0; } .ds-plate-frame { overflow: hidden; background: #e2d9c9; } .ds-plate img { display: block; width: 100%; aspect-ratio: 4/3; object-fit: cover; } .ds-plate figcaption { display: flex; gap: 16px; padding-top: 10px; font: 10px Karla, Arial, sans-serif; letter-spacing: .12em; text-transform: uppercase; color: #4a5a4c; } .ds-plate-no { color: #a45436; }

narrative.overview: An uncoated-paper world built around the rituals of a small mountain house. The page reads as a bound record of a place: folio labels, plate numbers, hairline rules, and photographs tipped in with printed margins. It is quiet but not timid — scale does the work where ornament would. The palette is drawn from paper, ink, moss, and a single rust reserved for numbers, live state, and emphasis. Depth comes from paper layers and photography, never from floating cards. Motion is authored sparingly and settles into stillness.
keyCharacteristics: Paper-first surfaces with hairline rules and generous margins
Oversized display serif contrasted with tiny tracked labels
Photographs presented as numbered plates with captions
One rust accent used as a signal, never as decoration
Flat surfaces; depth from layering and scale

rules.name: The Rust Is a Signal Rule
rules.body: Rust appears on numbers, current state, and action only. It never fills a large field.

rules.name: The Label Whisper Rule
rules.body: Labels stay below 12px and widely tracked; headings carry the volume.

dos: Do keep the rust accent to signals and numbers.
Do present imagery with plate numbers and captions.
Do keep all paper surfaces flat and separated by hairlines.
Do use self-hosted Gloock and Karla only.
donts: Don't add rounded cards, gradients, or glass panels.
Don't use a centred hero over a row of equal amenity cards.
Don't label illustrative prices or availability as real.
Don't copy imagery or branding from an existing hotel site.
